entity_type.description: One of: project, span, spend_lane, spend_session, thread, trace.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

fields.description: Return only these paths of the record, uncut: dotted into nested objects ('trace.output'), arrays whole ('spans'). The record's id is always kept; an unknown path is refused with the valid ones. The answer says it was projected and what it omitted. Omit for the whole record.
fields.title: Fields

id.description: UUID, full opik:// URI or a pasted Opik link; a lane name for spend_lane, a session id for spend_session. A URI or link overrides entity_type.
id.title: Id

since.description: Start of the window, as a relative span ('7d', '24h') or an ISO-8601 instant with timezone. Moves a project summary's period (7d by default) and the spend types' window.
since.title: Since

until.description: End of the window, same forms as since.
until.title: Until
